name: ZAO
description: Structure is shared, finish is chosen. The structure set holds everything that decides size and layout. The theme modifier picks a finish (palettes, radius, material, motion, display face). The mode modifier maps semantic colors to palette steps.

structure.description: Shared by every finish: the fen unit, spacing, control sizes and type roles.

theme.description: The finish. Su 素 is plain; Yu 玉 is jade.

mode.description: Light or dark. Yu ships dark only in v0.1.
